reached_sql:
SELECT substr(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
       avg(ws.ws_quantity),
       avg(wr.wr_refunded_cash),
       avg(wr.wr_fee)
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN web_returns wr
  ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
 AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
JOIN web_page wp
  ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN date_dim d
  ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd1
  ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
JOIN (VALUES ('D','Primary'), ('S','College'), ('U','Advanced Degree')) AS db(cd_marital_status, cd_education_status)
  ON cd1.cd_marital_status = db.cd_marital_status
 AND cd1.cd_education_status = db.cd_education_status
 AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN CASE db.cd_marital_status
                                WHEN 'D' THEN 100.00
                                WHEN 'S' THEN 50.00
                                WHEN 'U' THEN 150.00
                            END
                            AND CASE db.cd_marital_status
                                WHEN 'D' THEN 150.00
                                WHEN 'S' THEN 100.00
                                WHEN 'U' THEN 200.00
                            END
JOIN customer_demographics cd2
  ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
 AND cd2.cd_marital_status = cd1.cd_marital_status
 AND cd2.cd_education_status = cd1.cd_education_status
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
JOIN (VALUES ('NC'),('TX'),('IA'),('WI'),('WV'),('GA'),('OK'),('VA'),('KY')) AS ab(ca_state)
  ON ca.ca_state = ab.ca_state
 AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN CASE ab.ca_state
                                WHEN 'NC' THEN 100
                                WHEN 'TX' THEN 100
                                WHEN 'IA' THEN 100
                                WHEN 'WI' THEN 150
                                WHEN 'WV' THEN 150
                                WHEN 'GA' THEN 150
                                WHEN 'OK' THEN 50
                                WHEN 'VA' THEN 50
                                WHEN 'KY' THEN 50
                            END
                            AND CASE ab.ca_state
                                WHEN 'NC' THEN 200
                                WHEN 'TX' THEN 200
                                WHEN 'IA' THEN 200
                                WHEN 'WI' THEN 300
                                WHEN 'WV' THEN 300
                                WHEN 'GA' THEN 300
                                WHEN 'OK' THEN 250
                                WHEN 'VA' THEN 250
                                WHEN 'KY' THEN 250
                            END
JOIN reason r
  ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 1998
  AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4
LIMIT 100
